blocks.content: Your alert rule is active. Check its current state and see how it has behaved over time to confirm the threshold is set correctly.
To check your rule's state, complete the following steps:
Navigate to **Alerts & IRM > Alerting > Alert rules** if you're not already there.
Click on your alert rule to open the detail view.

Check the current **state** of the rule.

The **State history** tab shows how the alert has behaved over time. This helps you tell if the threshold is set correctly or if the alert is firing too frequently.
You can see your rule's current state and history. Next, you'll verify that notifications are delivered.
